body.name: MixtureHandle
body.def: null-preserving full-observation mixture program: perturb the four Bernoulli cell-probability surfaces on a smooth regular partition, enforce constant \(\tau\) in every null draw, moment-match transition regions under exact \(X\sim\lambda\), and optimize the resulting \(\chi^2\) or Hellinger bound subject to the separate \(\mathcal H^\alpha(L)\), \(\mathcal H^\beta(L)\), and \(\mathcal H^\gamma(L)\) constraints
body.role: concrete starting move for deriving, rather than guessing, the sharp observational rate
